# Markoholics

> Markoholics is an AI-native GTM (go-to-market) partner for Series A-C tech founders. We run strategy, content, performance marketing, demand generation, and AI operations as one autonomous growth system instead of five disconnected vendors or freelancers.

Markoholics works with tech, SaaS, and AI-native companies across the US, UK, Singapore, and Dubai. Engagements are outcome-based, not time-based, and start with a GTM audit or a strategy call.

## Services and pricing (outcome-based)

- [Services overview](https://www.markoholics.com/services): GTM strategy, content marketing, social media marketing, performance marketing, demand generation and growth marketing, and AI strategy and transformation.
- GTM Audit ($500 one-time): Full-funnel diagnostic and GTM system review.
- Growth Engine ($3,500/month): Full execution across strategy, content, paid, social, and demand generation.
- AI-First Scale ($6,500/month): Growth Engine plus custom AI workflow design and AI operations.

## Work

- [Case studies index](https://www.markoholics.com/work): Selected GTM engagements with real pipeline, revenue, and activation results.
- [EQRGen](https://www.markoholics.com/work/eqrgen): Dynamic QR infrastructure — 500 sales-qualified leads and 50 new customers in one quarter.
- [Byosync](https://www.markoholics.com/work/byosync): Trust and consent infrastructure — $500K+ in POC pipeline across 3 markets in 6 months.

- [Markoholics vs. Other AI-Native GTM Platforms](https://www.markoholics.com/blog/markoholics-vs-ai-native-gtm-platforms): How Markoholics compares to Clay, ColdIQ, and TripleDart.
